description: 4 players play the Public Goods Game for exactly 10 rounds. You cannot speak to the other players. Each round, secretly contribute 0-10 tokens to a shared pool. Pool is multiplied by 1.5 and split equally among all players. You keep tokens you didn't contribute. After each round, individual contributions are revealed. GOAL: Maximize your own earnings over the 10 rounds. IMPORTANT: The top 2 earners (top half) WIN and the bottom 2 earners LOSE. Your ranking relative to others matters more than absolute earnings. Players: {agent_names}.

role_goals.Player: Maximize your own earnings over 10 rounds. The top 2 earners win and the bottom 2 lose. Your relative ranking matters.
